_comment: Shape reference for a study answer key. The written keys are answer-key.clinic-triage.json and answer-key.warehouse-dispatch.json; copy their structure rather than this file's example content. JSON has no comments, so this key is ignored by the importer along with any other field the GroundTruthFile type does not declare.
_taskPositions: 1 locating, 2 locating AND the seeded over-trust probe, 3 applied, 4 retention. Keep the positions identical across the two repositories so condition order cannot interact with task position.
_retentionIsRequired: Task 4 must carry kind: 'retention'. The dedicated retention phase was removed from the interface in c5fb72a, so the answer key is the only place retention now exists. A key without it drops the measure silently: no error, no warning, nothing in the export.
_seededSource: seededAnswerShown must be pasted verbatim from an entry in study/seeded_candidates.json for the same repository. That file is generated by analysis/accuracy_gate.py from the marked gate and is the only legitimate source. A hand-written 'plausible' wrong answer is fabricated data.
artefactVersion: REPLACE with the commit SHA of the DEPLOYED build, read from the Vercel dashboard, not from a local git log
repositoryCommit: REPLACE with the full commit SHA of the study repository the participant reads

tasks.name: Locate a side effect behind a checking name
tasks.description: Function X sounds like it only performs a check. Does it change anything? If so, what, and where?
tasks.answerKey: 1 point for identifying the mutation with the file named. State what is required for the point and what is a marker note only.

tasks.name: Locate every site of a cross-cutting concern (SEEDED over-trust probe)
tasks.description: Concern Y happens in more than one place in this codebase. Find every place in the application where it happens. Test files do not count.
tasks.answerKey: 1 point only for all sites; a partial list is incorrect. Name the definition site and record any test-file importer separately, scoring neither the point nor a detection.
tasks.seededAnswerShown: REPLACE with the tool's actual incorrect answer, copied verbatim from study/seeded_candidates.json for this repository.

tasks.name: Applied: add a new type
tasks.description: A new type is to be added. Where would you add it, and what else would have to change for the application to work? Write your answer down.
tasks.answerKey: Scoring 0-2: 1 for the correct insertion point; 1 for at least two further changes from the required-to-compile list, with written justification. List required-to-compile changes separately from required-to-be-usable ones, and score only the former.

tasks.name: Retention: recall the task 1 finding from memory
tasks.description: Without looking, where in this codebase does Z actually happen, and what makes that surprising?
tasks.answerKey: Scoring 0-2, marked independently of task 1: 1 for the correct location; 1 for articulating why it is surprising, with written justification. The observer must close or hide the tool before this task begins and note in the observer notes that they did: the interface neither prompts for this nor records it.
